subject: cave spider
title: A New Fungus Drives Cave Spiders Out of Hiding to Die

scenes.text: Spiders that hide in the dark start walking toward the light.
They're orb-weaving cave spiders, and normally they stay tucked in their webs.
In twenty twenty-one, a BBC crew in Northern Ireland found one dead in the open.
It was coated in a fungus no one had ever named.
Infected spiders leave their webs and die on bare walls, where scientists think airflow spreads its spores.
Its name honors David Attenborough. The walk toward the light is the fungus, not the spider.

description:
Cave spiders that normally hide in their webs are leaving them to die out in the open.
The cause is a fungus first spotted in 2021 by a BBC Winterwatch crew in Northern Ireland and named Gibellula attenboroughii in 2025. Infected spiders die on exposed cave walls and ceilings, where scientists think air currents help spread the spores.
Would you go into that cave?
first_comment: The first one was found on the ceiling of an old gunpowder store, not a cave. What would you name the next zombie fungus?
